017package org.apache.juneau.terminal.region;

019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.IoUtils.readCapped;
020import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
021import static org.apache.juneau.terminal.report.TerminalViewChecks.*;
022
023import java.io.*;
024import java.nio.*;
025import java.nio.channels.*;
026import java.nio.charset.*;
027import java.nio.file.*;
028import java.nio.file.attribute.*;
029import java.util.*;

034import org.apache.juneau.marshall.marshaller.Json;

036/**
037 * A {@link TerminalSource} that tails one growing log file of raw terminal bytes.
038 *
039 * <p>
040 * <b>Size.</b> The producer's cols&times;rows come from the sidecar {@code <log>.size}, which holds
041 * {@code {"cols":C,"rows":R}}.  While it is missing or malformed the size is {@link #DEFAULT_COLS}&times;
042 * {@link #DEFAULT_ROWS} and one warning is logged; the first valid read is kept, since the sidecar is written once.
043 *
044 * <p>
045 * <b>Done.</b> The source is done when the {@link Builder#terminal(BooleanSupplier) terminal} supplier says so and
046 * the reader has reached the end.  <b>Gone.</b> A log that existed and then disappears answers a {@code gone},
047 * {@code done}, empty chunk whose {@code next} and {@code end} are the requested offset.
048 *
049 * <p>
050 * <b>Nudges.</b> {@link #nudges(String, TerminalNudgePublisher)} starts a daemon watcher that publishes when the file
051 * grows.  A source has no process exit, so it never publishes a {@code done} nudge: the page's polling already sees
052 * {@code done} through the {@link Builder#terminal(BooleanSupplier) terminal} supplier.  Call {@link #close()} to stop
053 * the watcher.
054 *
055 * <p>
056 * <b>Path safety.</b> The application supplies the {@link Path}; nothing in a request ever becomes a path.
057 *
058 * <h2 class='section'>Example:</h2>
059 * <p class='bjava'>
060 *    FileTerminalSource <jv>src</jv> = FileTerminalSource.<jsm>create</jsm>(<jv>dir</jv>.resolve(<js>"run.log"</js>))
061 *       .terminal(() -&gt; <jv>run</jv>.isFinished())
062 *       .build();
063 * </p>
064 */
065public final class FileTerminalSource implements TerminalSource, AutoCloseable {
066
067   /** The width used while the size sidecar is missing or malformed. */
068   public static final int DEFAULT_COLS = 120;
069
070   /** The height used while the size sidecar is missing or malformed. */
071   public static final int DEFAULT_ROWS = 40;
072
073   /** How often the nudge thread checks the file size, in milliseconds. */
074   static final int NUDGE_POLL_MILLIS = 100;
075
076   /** How long {@link #close()} waits for the nudge thread, in milliseconds. */
077   static final int NUDGE_JOIN_MILLIS = 1000;
078
079   /** The most bytes read from the size sidecar. */
080   static final int MAX_SIZE_BYTES = 32;
081
082   private static final Logger LOG = Logger.getLogger(FileTerminalSource.class.getName());
083
084   /**
085    * Builder for {@link FileTerminalSource}.
086    */
087   public static final class Builder {
088      private final Path file;
089      private BooleanSupplier terminal = () -> false;
090
091      Builder(Path file) {
092         this.file = Objects.requireNonNull(file, "file");
093      }
094
095      /**
096       * Sets the supplier that reports whether the producer will write no more, called once per read before the
097       * file is sized.
098       *
099       * @param value The supplier.
100       * @return This object.
101       */
102      public Builder terminal(BooleanSupplier value) {
103         terminal = Objects.requireNonNull(value, "terminal");
104         return this;
105      }
106
107      /**
108       * Builds the source.
109       *
110       * @return A new source.
111       */
112      public FileTerminalSource build() {
113         return new FileTerminalSource(this);
114      }
115   }
116
117   private final Path file;
118   private final Path sizeFile;
119   private final BooleanSupplier terminal;
120   private final AtomicReference<int[]> sizeRef = new AtomicReference<>();
121   private final AtomicReference<Object> fileKey = new AtomicReference<>();
122   private volatile boolean seen;
123   private volatile boolean warned;
124
125   // Nudges.  nudgeThread, nudgeSet and nudgeClosed are guarded by nudgeLock.
126   private final Object nudgeLock = new Object();
127   private Thread nudgeThread;
128   private boolean nudgeSet;
129   private boolean nudgeClosed;
130   private volatile boolean nudgeStop;
131
132   private FileTerminalSource(Builder b) {
133      file = b.file;
134      sizeFile = file.resolveSibling(file.getFileName() + ".size");
135      terminal = b.terminal;
136   }
137
138   /**
139    * Creates a builder.
140    *
141    * @param file The log file, supplied by the application.
142    * @return A new builder.
143    */
144   public static Builder create(Path file) {
145      return new Builder(file);
146   }
147
148   /**
149    * The log file.
150    *
151    * @return The path given to {@link #create(Path)}.
152    */
153   public Path file() {
154      return file;
155   }
156
157   /**
158    * Reports growth of the file to a publisher.
159    *
160    * <p>
161    * Starts a daemon thread named {@code juneau-terminal-nudge-file-<name>} that checks the file size every 100 ms and
162    * calls the publisher with the new end when it has grown.  A file that is missing or has shrunk publishes nothing
163    * and the watcher keeps going.  A {@link RuntimeException} thrown by the publisher is logged at {@code FINE} and
164    * otherwise ignored.  No {@code done} nudge is ever published, since the source does not know when the producer
165    * finishes; polling covers it.  {@link #close()} stops the thread.
166    *
167    * @param terminalId The terminal id passed to the publisher; must be a valid run id.
168    * @param publisher The publisher.
169    * @return This object.
170    * @throws NullPointerException If an argument is <jk>null</jk>.
171    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If the id is not a valid run id.
172    * @throws IllegalStateException If a publisher is already set, or this source has been closed.
173    */
174   public FileTerminalSource nudges(String terminalId, TerminalNudgePublisher publisher) {
175      Objects.requireNonNull(terminalId, "terminalId");
176      Objects.requireNonNull(publisher, "publisher");
177      if (! isRunId(terminalId))
178         throw iaex("FileTerminalSource nudge id is not a valid run id: '%s'.", terminalId);
179      synchronized (nudgeLock) {
180         if (nudgeClosed)
181            throw new IllegalStateException("FileTerminalSource is closed.");
182         if (nudgeSet)
183            throw new IllegalStateException("FileTerminalSource nudges are already set.");
184         nudgeSet = true;
185         nudgeThread = new Thread(() -> watch(terminalId, publisher), "juneau-terminal-nudge-file-" + file.getFileName());
186         nudgeThread.setDaemon(true);
187         nudgeThread.start();
188      }
189      return this;
190   }
191
192   /** The nudge thread: reports file growth until the thread is stopped. */
193   private void watch(String id, TerminalNudgePublisher publisher) {
194      var last = -1L;
195      while (! nudgeStop) {
196         var size = sizeOrZero(file);
197         if (size > last) {
198            try {
199               publisher.nudge(id, size, false);
200            } catch (RuntimeException e) {
201               LOG.log(Level.FINE, e, () -> "Terminal nudge publisher failed for '" + id + "'.");
202            }
203            last = size;
204         }
205         try {
206            Thread.sleep(NUDGE_POLL_MILLIS);
207         } catch (InterruptedException e) {
208            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
209            return;
210         }
211      }
212   }
213
214   private static long sizeOrZero(Path p) {
215      try {
216         return Files.size(p);
217      } catch (IOException e) {
218         return 0;
219      }
220   }
221
222   /**
223    * Stops the nudge thread, if any, and waits up to {@value #NUDGE_JOIN_MILLIS} ms for it.
224    *
225    * <p>
226    * Reads keep working after this; only {@link #nudges(String, TerminalNudgePublisher)} is refused.
227    */
228   @Override /* AutoCloseable */
229   public void close() {
230      Thread t;
231      synchronized (nudgeLock) {
232         nudgeClosed = true;
233         nudgeStop = true;
234         t = nudgeThread;
235      }
236      if (t == null)
237         return;
238      t.interrupt();
239      try {
240         t.join(NUDGE_JOIN_MILLIS);
241      } catch (InterruptedException e) {
242         Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
243      }
244      if (t.isAlive())
245         LOG.log(Level.WARNING, () -> "FileTerminalSource nudge thread did not stop for '" + file + "'.");
246   }
247
248   @Override /* TerminalSource */
249   public TerminalChunk read(long fromOffset, int maxBytes) throws IOException {
250      if (fromOffset < 0)
251         throw iaex("fromOffset must be at least 0; got '%s'.", fromOffset);
252      // Read the flag first: bytes written after this point are simply not done yet, and the next read sees them.
253      var done = terminal.getAsBoolean();
254      var sz = size();
255      long end;
256      try {
257         var attrs = Files.readAttributes(file, BasicFileAttributes.class, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS);
258         if (! attrs.isRegularFile())
259            throw new IOException("Terminal log is not a regular file: '" + file + "'.");
260         var key = attrs.fileKey();
261         if (key != null && ! fileKey.compareAndSet(null, key) && ! key.equals(fileKey.get()))
262            throw new IOException("Terminal log was replaced: '" + file + "'.");
263         end = attrs.size();
264      } catch (NoSuchFileException e) {
265         if (seen)
266            return gone(fromOffset, sz);
267         return new TerminalChunk(new byte[0], 0, 0, done, sz[0], sz[1], false, false);
268      }
269      seen = true;
270      if (fromOffset >= end)
271         return new TerminalChunk(new byte[0], end, end, done, sz[0], sz[1], false, false);
272      var len = (int)Math.min(Math.max(0, Math.min(maxBytes, MAX_READ_BYTES)), end - fromOffset);
273      var buf = ByteBuffer.allocate(len);
274      try (var ch = FileChannel.open(file, StandardOpenOption.READ, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) {
275         while (buf.hasRemaining()) {
276            if (ch.read(buf, fromOffset + buf.position()) < 0)
277               break;
278         }
279      } catch (NoSuchFileException e) {
280         return gone(fromOffset, sz);
281      }
282      var bytes = Arrays.copyOf(buf.array(), buf.position());
283      var next = fromOffset + bytes.length;
284      return new TerminalChunk(bytes, next, end, done && next == end, sz[0], sz[1], false, false);
285   }
286
287   private static TerminalChunk gone(long fromOffset, int[] sz) {
288      return new TerminalChunk(new byte[0], fromOffset, fromOffset, true, sz[0], sz[1], false, true);
289   }
290
291   private int[] size() {
292      var s = sizeRef.get();
293      if (s != null)
294         return s;
295      s = parseSize(sizeFile);
296      if (s != null) {
297         sizeRef.set(s);
298         return s;
299      }
300      if (! warned) {
301         warned = true;
302         LOG.warning(() -> "Terminal size sidecar '" + sizeFile + "' is missing or malformed; using " + DEFAULT_COLS + "x" + DEFAULT_ROWS + ".");
303      }
304      return new int[] { DEFAULT_COLS, DEFAULT_ROWS };
305   }
306
307   /** Returns {cols, rows} from a {"cols":C,"rows":R} file, or null when it is missing or malformed. */
308   @SuppressWarnings({
309      "java:S1168" // null means the size sidecar is missing or malformed; callers test for it
310   })
311   static int[] parseSize(Path p) {
312      try {
313         var m = Json.to(readCapped(p, MAX_SIZE_BYTES, StandardCharsets.UTF_8, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS), Map.class);
314         if (m.get("cols") instanceof Number c && m.get("rows") instanceof Number r) {
315            var cols = c.doubleValue();
316            var rows = r.doubleValue();
317            if (cols == Math.rint(cols) && rows == Math.rint(rows) && cols >= 1 && cols <= 9999 && rows >= 1 && rows <= 9999)
318               return new int[] { (int)cols, (int)rows };
319         }
320         return null;
321      } catch (Exception e) {
322         return null;
323      }
324   }
325}
